summary: Iteration 10 (Risk/Vendor Detail Tabs + Vendor Schedule Review + Assurance Expiry Alerts + Weekly Digest vendor bucket). Backend: 6/6 pytest passing — POST /api/vendors/{id}/schedule-review returns 200 with review_type=vendor, review is inserted into /reviews (also visible in list), vendor.next_review is updated; POST /api/reminders/send-weekly-now returns ok=true with stats.emails_sent >=0 (vendor assurance bucket wired without error); GET /api/dashboard returns assurance_alerts key and contains flagged vendor after PATCH assurance_status=expiring; 404 on unknown vendor; risk create computes risk_score=20 and risk_level (critical/high); vendor create persists data_types. Frontend (Playwright, platform.admin@grc.demo scoped to Globex): Risk drawer renders all 6 tabs (overview/assessment/treatment/related/history/activity) with correct data-testids; Overview shows data-testid=risk-actions-panel with data-testid=risk-mark-reviewed (Mark reviewed) and data-testid=risk-accept (Accept risk) buttons; Assessment tab shows data-testid=risk-live-score with 'Score 25 → Critical' updating live. Vendor drawer renders all 8 tabs (overview/data_access/assurance/reviews_tab/actions_tab/risks_tab/contract/activity) with correct data-testids. Vendor Schedule Review flow (Vendors > row > tab-reviews_tab > vendor-schedule-review > date pick > schedule-submit) fires POST /api/vendors/{id}/schedule-review -> 200. Dashboard panel data-testid=panel-assurance-alerts renders with 'Assurance Expiry Alerts' listing vendor name, criticality, assurance status, renewal date. Regression: generic drawer for findings and policies still has the correct 5 tabs (overview/related/evidence/comments/activity) with no risk/vendor-only tabs leaking in; Save changes button still present.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3037 lines — still growing beyond the 700-line guideline. Consider splitting reviews/vendors/risks/dashboard into feature modules.

GET-by-id is not exposed on the generic entity router (only list/create/patch/delete). Tests had to fall back to filtering the list. Not a bug for this iteration but worth exposing GET /api/{kind}/{item_id} for cleaner API contract.
VendorScheduleReviewIn.due_date accepts any string; consider Pydantic validation for ISO date to prevent silently-mangled review dates.

vendor_schedule_review sets due_iso from body.due_date but if the client sends only YYYY-MM-DD the code appends T00:00:00+00:00 — good. However vendor.next_review comparison relies on substring 'in' — spec/tests should treat this as date-only field for consistency.
RecordDrawer.jsx is >1200 lines with TABS_BY_KIND branching for kind-specific tabs; consider extracting per-kind tab components to reduce coupling.
test_credentials: platform.admin@grc.demo / Demo@2026 (used for UI + API tests). contributor@acme.demo lands with no client selected in the sidebar switcher (org selector shows 'Select...') — non-blocking here since prior iterations already verified contributor scope; used platform admin scoped to Globex for UI runs.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend & UI for iteration 10 are green.
